submission.implementation_notes: Scalus 1.3.0. Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one Plutus V3 script (`@Compile object TwoPartyEscrowValidator`, `Data -> Unit`) that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. Minting with redeemer 0 is the deposit and minting with redeemer 1 or 2 is the burn; spending with redeemer 1 is Accept and with redeemer 2 is Refund. The buyer and seller keys, the 75 ADA price, the 30-minute (1800000 ms) delay and the token name are compiled in; the datum is `Constr 0 [depositTime]`, where `depositTime` is the finite upper bound of the deposit validity range minus one millisecond. The validator enforces one escrow input per spend and sums payments by payment credential. Targets the van Rossem protocol version (Cardano protocol version 11), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18. Compiled once with the release options (Scala 3.3.8, `scalus-plugin` 1.3.0). The two token-quantity lookups, in the escrow output and in the mint, compile to the CIP-153 `unValueData` and `lookupCoin` builtins.
